# Demo

[![CI](https://github.com/o/r/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/o/r/actions)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

Demo is a **small** tool for `parsing` things.
It has a second line.

## Install

See the [guide](docs/guide.md#install) and the [API][api].

### Linux

```sh
cargo install demo
# not a heading
```

### macOS

Use [Homebrew](https://brew.sh) or read <https://example.com>.

## Usage

Run `demo --help`. Contact [us](mailto:team@example.com).
Jump to [install](#install).

![diagram](docs/img/flow.png "Flow")

-----------

Setext headings nest like ATX ones.
